**Part 1 – Why the model gave this decision**  
The model looks at a few key signals. It saw one recent 30‑to‑59‑day past‑due payment, which pushes the default risk upward. It also noted that you have 19 open credit lines and loans; having many accounts can increase risk because there are more potential obligations. On the positive side, your revolving‑credit utilization is low (about 15 % of the available limit), and that helps pull the risk down. Taken together, these factors led the system to label the application as “low risk,” even though the calculated probability of default is around 43 %.
